actor.ratio_denominator: Exact before-checkpoint reconstructed full logits; saved actual selected logit atol1e-6 and probability atol2e-6 independently checked
actor.structural_inability: strict base top1-top2 gap > .5; single legal actions reported separately; .5 may at most tie under closed amplitude bounds

critic.C1: Direct normalized L/n,K/n softplus,H/n signed; .5*sum(component errors^2)
critic.C2: C1 + .5*(composed value - complete RTG)^2; value loss coefficient1
critic.initializer: Identical raw net tensors from default RemainingCostCritic initialization, manual_seed11622026; no fitted bias initialization. C0 raw units and C1/C2 normalized units yield different initial physical predictions; both initial and final results mandatory.
critic.references: Fitting fold only, parent equal / trajectory equal / state mean. Global and window x observable progress bin floor(4*(1-v[256])); unknown bins fall back to fitting global.
critic.state_reduction: state mean within each trajectory, then equal mean across parent-balanced batch trajectories; differs from old PPO state SUM and never replaces old stop metric

failure_policy: Debit before forward/backward/optimizer. One-shot journal refuses restart. Failures and paid work retained; any code repair requires explicit same-budget receipt, never reset/rerun as new study.
preflight_scope: Source inspection, hashes and schedule identities only; no new numerical model/state/label diagnostic, forward or optimizer
selection_rule: phase(1:64/65:128) x size(10x10,4x3,6x6,8x8), eight ON/OFF pairs per stratum; hash-ordered physical-parent round-robin then hash-ordered within-parent rows
user_authorized: 2026-11-11 explicit bounded offline diagnostic task; max128 trajectories,3x256 Critic steps,3600s; no joint PPO
